# Sage Business Cloud Accounting (South Africa) - Comprehensive Feature Analysis

> **Purpose:** Competitive comparison reference document for ISAFlow
> **Product:** Sage Business Cloud Accounting (formerly Sage One / Sage 0)
> **Region:** South Africa (en-za)
> **Last Updated:** 2026-04-05

---

## Pricing Tiers (ZAR, incl. VAT)

| Plan | Price | Users | Target |
|------|-------|-------|--------|
| **Accounting Start** | From R240/month | 1 user | Sole traders, freelancers, micro-businesses |
| **Accounting Standard** | From R435/month | 2 users (up to 5) | Growing small businesses |
| **Add-on: Multi-Currency** | ~R165/month | - | Foreign currency transactions |
| **Add-on: Time Tracking** | R165/month | - | Project billing, hourly tracking |
| **Add-on: Advanced Inventory** | ~R165/month | - | Warehouse/stock management |
| **Add-on: Debtors Manager** | ~R165/month | - | Collections automation |
| **Sage Payroll** | Separate subscription | Per company | Payroll processing |

> Additional users can be added to Standard for an extra fee per user.

---

## 1. Dashboard & Overview

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Financial dashboard | Yes | All | Visual money in/out per month |
| Cash position widget | Yes | All | Real-time bank balance display |
| Outstanding invoices widget | Yes | All | Total owed by customers |
| Bills to pay widget | Yes | All | Total owed to suppliers |
| Profit & Loss summary | Yes | All | Current period P&L snapshot |
| Cash flow forecast chart | Yes | Standard | Visual forecast of future cash |
| Bank account balances | Yes | All | Connected bank accounts shown |
| Overdue invoices alert | Yes | All | Highlights overdue amounts |
| Customisable dashboard | Partial | All | Limited widget arrangement; not drag-and-drop customisable like Xero |
| KPI tiles/ratios | No | - | No gross margin %, current ratio, etc. on dashboard |
| Multi-company dashboard | No | - | Single company per login (no group overview) |

**Limitations:** Dashboard is functional but basic compared to competitors. No custom KPI widgets, no configurable date ranges on dashboard widgets, no sparkline trends.

---

## 2. Chart of Accounts / General Ledger

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Default chart of accounts | Yes | All | Pre-configured ZA-specific COA |
| Custom accounts | Yes | All | Add/edit/deactivate accounts |
| Account categories | Yes | All | Assets, Liabilities, Equity, Revenue, Expenses, Cost of Sales |
| Sub-accounts | Partial | All | Limited hierarchy; not true multi-level nesting |
| Journal entries | Yes | All | General journals with debit/credit |
| Recurring journals | Yes | Standard | Automated periodic journals |
| Opening balances | Yes | All | Via journal entry or take-on balance fields |
| Import COA from CSV | Yes | All | Bulk upload via CSV template |
| Account numbering | Yes | All | Customisable account codes |
| Lock periods | Yes | All | Prevent posting to closed periods |
| Tax codes per account | Yes | All | Default VAT rate per account |
| Departmental tracking | No | - | No tracking categories/departments (use Sage Intacct for this) |
| Multi-segment COA | No | - | Single-segment only |

**Limitations:** No tracking categories or cost centres. No multi-dimensional reporting. Cannot tag transactions to departments/locations/projects at the GL level (projects are a separate add-on). No account-level notes or attachments.

---

## 3. Customers / Accounts Receivable

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Customer contacts | Yes | All | Full customer database with contact details |
| Quotes/Estimates | Yes | All | Create, email, PDF |
| Convert quote to invoice | Yes | All | One-click conversion |
| Sales invoices | Yes | All | Professional templates, customisable |
| Pro-forma invoices | Yes | All | Supported |
| Credit notes | Yes | All | Against invoices or standalone |
| Draft invoices | Yes | All | Save as draft before sending |
| Recurring invoices | Yes | Standard | Automated at scheduled intervals; email auto-send or save as draft |
| Batch/quick entry invoices | Yes | Standard | Enter multiple invoices at once via Quick Entries |
| Customer statements | Yes | All | Generate and email statements |
| Aged Debtors report | Yes | All | 30/60/90/120+ day aging buckets |
| Customer payments/receipts | Yes | All | Record and allocate payments to invoices |
| Payment allocation | Yes | All | Match payments to specific invoices |
| Online invoice viewing | Yes | All | Customers get a link to view invoices online |
| Online quote acceptance | Yes | All | Customers can accept quotes online |
| Customer portal | Yes | All | View invoices, statements, accept quotes, pay online |
| Online card payments | Yes | All | Via Netcash/payment gateway integration |
| Delivery notes | Partial | All | Can be generated from invoices |
| Price lists | Yes | Standard | Trade, retail, distributor price lists per item |
| Customer-specific pricing | Yes | Standard | Assign default price list per customer |
| Discount management | Yes | All | Line-level and invoice-level discounts |
| Email invoices directly | Yes | All | Send from within Sage |
| Invoice templates | Yes | All | Customisable branding, logo, colours |
| Deposit invoices | Partial | All | Can record deposits but limited workflow |
| Foreign currency invoices | Yes | Add-on | Requires Multi-Currency module |
| Debtors Manager (collections) | Yes | Add-on | Automated chase workflow, overdue tracking |

**Limitations:** No approval workflows for invoices. No advanced credit limit management. No automated late payment interest calculation. Customer portal is functional but basic.

---

## 4. Suppliers / Accounts Payable

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Supplier contacts | Yes | All | Full supplier database |
| Supplier invoices | Yes | All | Enter and process purchase invoices |
| Supplier credit notes | Yes | All | Process returns/credits |
| Batch/quick entry bills | Yes | Standard | Via Quick Entries |
| Purchase orders | No | - | NOT available in Sage Business Cloud Accounting. Requires Sage Intacct |
| Supplier payments | Yes | All | Record payments against invoices |
| Batch payments | Yes | Standard | Via Netcash integration; select invoices, generate batch file |
| Payment allocation | Yes | All | Match payments to supplier invoices |
| Aged Creditors report | Yes | All | 30/60/90/120+ day aging |
| Supplier statements reconciliation | Partial | All | Manual comparison |
| Recurring bills | Yes | Standard | Automated periodic supplier invoices |
| Remittance advice | Yes | All | Generate and send to suppliers |
| Approval workflows | No | - | No bill approval process. Requires Sage Intacct |
| Spend limits | No | - | No per-user spending limits |
| Three-way matching (PO/GRN/Invoice) | No | - | No PO module = no matching |

**Limitations:** The absence of purchase orders is a significant gap. No approval workflows for bills. No automated supplier payment runs via EFT (batch payments require Netcash add-on). No OCR/AI bill capture natively (third-party tools required).

---

## 5. Banking & Reconciliation

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Automatic bank feeds | Yes | All | Direct feeds from major SA banks |
| Supported banks | Yes | All | FNB, Standard Bank, Nedbank, ABSA, Capitec, 30+ banks |
| Manual bank statement import | Yes | All | CSV, QIF, OFX file formats |
| Bank reconciliation | Yes | All | Match imported transactions to accounting entries |
| Bank rules | Yes | All | Auto-categorise transactions based on rules |
| Suggested matches | Yes | All | Auto-matching of bank lines to invoices/bills |
| Bank transfers | Yes | All | Record transfers between accounts |
| Multiple bank accounts | Yes | All | Add unlimited bank/credit card accounts |
| Credit card accounts | Yes | All | Treated as bank accounts |
| Petty cash account | Yes | All | Supported |
| Foreign currency bank accounts | Yes | Add-on | Requires Multi-Currency module |
| Bank reconciliation report | Yes | All | Reconciled vs unreconciled view |
| Unreconciled transactions report | Yes | All | List of outstanding items |
| Auto-reconciliation | Partial | All | Rules-based but not fully automatic |
| Split transactions | Yes | All | Split a single bank line across multiple accounts |
| Batch reconciliation | Partial | All | Process multiple lines but one at a time |

**Limitations:** Bank rules are basic compared to competitors (simple keyword matching). No AI-powered categorisation of bank transactions. No batch approval of reconciled items. Bank feeds can have delays of 1-2 days depending on the bank.

---

## 6. Reporting

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| **Financial Reports** | | | |
| Profit & Loss (Income Statement) | Yes | All | With date range, comparison periods |
| Balance Sheet | Yes | All | As at any date |
| Trial Balance | Yes | All | With period filtering |
| Cash Flow Statement | Yes | Standard | Direct method |
| Cash Flow Forecast | Yes | Standard | Visual forecast based on receivables/payables |
| **Transaction Reports** | | | |
| General Ledger | Yes | All | Full transaction detail per account |
| Sales Day Book | Yes | All | All sales transactions |
| Purchase Day Book | Yes | All | All purchase transactions |
| Receipts & Payments Day Book | Yes | All | Cash-based report |
| **AR/AP Reports** | | | |
| Aged Debtors (AR Aging) | Yes | All | By customer, aging buckets |
| Aged Creditors (AP Aging) | Yes | All | By supplier, aging buckets |
| Customer activity | Yes | All | Transaction history per customer |
| Supplier activity | Yes | All | Transaction history per supplier |
| **Tax Reports** | | | |
| VAT summary | Yes | Standard | VAT collected vs paid |
| VAT return (VAT201) | Yes | Standard | SARS-compliant format |
| **Other Reports** | | | |
| Audit Trail | Yes | All | Full transaction log |
| Chart of Accounts listing | Yes | All | Exportable |
| Profit analysis | Yes | Standard | By item/category |
| Sales revenue by product/service | Yes | Standard | Item-level revenue analysis |
| **Report Features** | | | |
| Export to PDF | Yes | All | All reports |
| Export to CSV | Yes | All | All reports |
| Comparative periods | Partial | All | Prior period comparison on P&L and Balance Sheet |
| Custom date ranges | Yes | All | Flexible date filtering |
| Custom reports | No | - | Cannot build custom report layouts |
| Report scheduling/email | No | - | No automated report distribution |
| Financial ratios | No | - | No built-in ratio calculations |
| Budget vs Actual report | Yes | Standard | Compare actual to budget |
| Consolidated reports | No | - | No multi-entity consolidation (Sage Intacct required) |

**Limitations:** No custom report builder. No report scheduling. No management report packs. Limited comparison options (single prior period only). No drill-down from dashboard to underlying transactions on all widgets. No ratio analysis.

---

## 7. VAT / Tax

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| VAT registration support | Yes | Standard | Set up VAT registration details |
| VAT rates configuration | Yes | Standard | Standard (15%), Zero-rated, Exempt, Input/Output |
| VAT on invoices/bills | Yes | Standard | Auto-calculated per line item |
| VAT201 preparation | Yes | Standard | Auto-generated from transactions |
| VAT201 electronic submission | Yes | Standard | Direct to SARS eFiling via Accountants Edition |
| SARS eFiling integration | Yes | Standard | Via ISV activation on SARS eFiling |
| VAT reconciliation | Partial | Standard | Summary report; manual verification needed |
| Income tax calculation | No | - | Not a tax computation tool |
| Provisional tax (IRP6) | No | - | Not supported |
| Tax certificates | No | - | Via Sage Payroll only |

**Limitations:** VAT201 electronic submission can only be done once per period via software (SARS limitation). Resubmissions require manual filing. VAT return is basic; no detailed input/output tax analysis. No Tax section 11 tracking. No customs duty or import VAT tracking.

---

## 8. Payroll

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Employee management | Yes | Separate product | Sage Business Cloud Payroll (separate subscription) |
| Pay runs | Yes | Payroll | Monthly, bi-weekly processing |
| Payslips | Yes | Payroll | Customisable, emailable |
| IRP5 tax certificates | Yes | Payroll | Auto-generated, SARS compliant |
| EMP201 monthly submission | Yes | Payroll | Compile and submit to SARS |
| EMP501 reconciliation | Yes | Payroll | Interim and annual |
| UIF declarations | Yes | Payroll | Department of Labour submission |
| Leave management | Yes | Payroll | BCEA-compliant leave tracking |
| Leave reports | Yes | Payroll | Accrual and usage reports |
| SDL (Skills Development Levy) | Yes | Payroll | Auto-calculated |
| PAYE calculation | Yes | Payroll | Annual tax tables auto-updated |
| Integration with Accounting | Yes | Payroll | Journal posting to Sage Accounting |
| Overtime calculation | Yes | Payroll | Configurable rates |
| Benefits/deductions | Yes | Payroll | Medical aid, pension, etc. |
| Cost-to-company packages | Yes | Payroll | CTC structure support |
| Employee self-service | Partial | Payroll | Limited; view payslips |
| Time & attendance integration | No | Payroll | No biometric/clock integration |
| HR module | Partial | Payroll | Basic employee records; full HR via Sage Premier HR |

**Limitations:** Payroll is a SEPARATE product with its own subscription -- not included in Sage Accounting. Integration is via journal entry, not real-time sync. No advanced HR features (performance management, recruitment) in the basic payroll. No time & attendance hardware integration.

---

## 9. Fixed Assets

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Fixed asset register | No | - | NOT included in Sage Business Cloud Accounting |
| Depreciation calculation | No | - | Available in Sage Pastel, Sage 200 Evolution, or Sage Fixed Assets (separate products) |
| Asset disposal tracking | No | - | Separate product |
| Asset categories | No | - | Separate product |
| Depreciation methods | No | - | Straight-line and diminishing value available in Sage Fixed Assets |
| Asset barcode scanning | No | - | Separate product |
| SARS depreciation rates | No | - | Available in separate Sage Fixed Assets product |

**Limitations:** This is a major gap. Sage Business Cloud Accounting has NO built-in fixed asset management. Users must manually journal depreciation entries or purchase a separate Sage product (Sage Fixed Assets, Sage Pastel Partner, or Sage 200 Evolution).

---

## 10. Inventory / Items

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Item/product setup | Yes | Standard | Stock, non-stock, and service items |
| Bulk item import via CSV | Yes | Standard | Upload items from spreadsheet |
| Stock levels tracking | Yes | Standard | Basic quantity tracking |
| Price lists | Yes | Standard | Multiple price lists (trade, retail, distributor) |
| Customer-specific pricing | Yes | Standard | Default price list per customer |
| Average cost calculation | Yes | Standard | Weighted average cost method |
| Stock adjustments | Yes | Standard | Manual quantity/value adjustments |
| Item categories | Yes | Standard | Group items by category |
| Item notes/descriptions | Yes | Standard | Long and short descriptions |
| **Advanced Inventory (Add-on)** | | | |
| Real-time inventory updates | Yes | Add-on | Updates on every transaction |
| Inventory valuation report | Yes | Add-on | Current stock value |

## Summary: Competitive Strengths & Weaknesses

### Strengths
1. **Strong SA bank feed integration** -- direct feeds with all major SA banks
2. **SARS compliance** -- VAT201 electronic submission, payroll tax compliance
3. **Affordable entry price** -- R240/month for Start plan
4. **Customer portal** -- Online invoice viewing, quote acceptance, payments
5. **Mobile app** -- Functional iOS/Android app for on-the-go invoicing
6. **Recurring invoices** -- Automated scheduling with email delivery
7. **CaseWare integration** -- Important for SA accountants
8. **Netcash batch payments** -- Automated supplier payment processing
9. **Established brand** -- Trusted by SA accountants, large partner network

### Weaknesses
1. **No fixed asset management** -- Critical gap for SA businesses
2. **No purchase orders** -- Cannot do procurement workflow
3. **No AI features** -- All AI investment goes to Sage Intacct
4. **No custom reports** -- Cannot build bespoke report layouts
5. **No multi-entity/consolidation** -- Each company is isolated
6. **No OCR/document capture** -- Manual data entry required
7. **No approval workflows** -- For invoices, bills, or payments
8. **No tracking categories** -- Cannot tag transactions to departments/projects at GL level
9. **Basic inventory** -- No multi-warehouse, serial, batch, or assembly
10. **No WIP tracking** -- Inadequate for professional services firms
11. **Payroll is separate** -- Additional cost, not integrated real-time
12. **Feature gating via add-ons** -- Multi-currency, time tracking, inventory all cost extra
13. **No report scheduling** -- Cannot automate report distribution
14. **Limited budgeting** -- Single version, no forecasting
15. **Small app marketplace** -- Fewer integrations than Xero/QuickBooks

## Summary: Competitive Strengths & Weaknesses

### Strengths
1. **Strong SA bank feed integration** -- direct feeds with all major SA banks
2. **SARS compliance** -- VAT201 electronic submission, payroll tax compliance
3. **Affordable entry price** -- R240/month for Start plan
4. **Customer portal** -- Online invoice viewing, quote acceptance, payments
5. **Mobile app** -- Functional iOS/Android app for on-the-go invoicing
6. **Recurring invoices** -- Automated scheduling with email delivery
7. **CaseWare integration** -- Important for SA accountants
8. **Netcash batch payments** -- Automated supplier payment processing
9. **Established brand** -- Trusted by SA accountants, large partner network

### Weaknesses
1. **No fixed asset management** -- Critical gap for SA businesses
2. **No purchase orders** -- Cannot do procurement workflow
3. **No AI features** -- All AI investment goes to Sage Intacct
4. **No custom reports** -- Cannot build bespoke report layouts
5. **No multi-entity/consolidation** -- Each company is isolated
6. **No OCR/document capture** -- Manual data entry required
7. **No approval workflows** -- For invoices, bills, or payments
8. **No tracking categories** -- Cannot tag transactions to departments/projects at GL level
9. **Basic inventory** -- No multi-warehouse, serial, batch, or assembly
10. **No WIP tracking** -- Inadequate for professional services firms
11. **Payroll is separate** -- Additional cost, not integrated real-time
12. **Feature gating via add-ons** -- Multi-currency, time tracking, inventory all cost extra
13. **No report scheduling** -- Cannot automate report distribution
14. **Limited budgeting** -- Single version, no forecasting
15. **Small app marketplace** -- Fewer integrations than Xero/QuickBooks

# Sage Business Cloud Accounting (South Africa) - Comprehensive Feature Analysis

> **Purpose:** Competitive comparison reference document for ISAFlow
> **Product:** Sage Business Cloud Accounting (formerly Sage One / Sage 0)
> **Region:** South Africa (en-za)
> **Last Updated:** 2026-04-05

---

## Pricing Tiers (ZAR, incl. VAT)

| Plan | Price | Users | Target |
|------|-------|-------|--------|
| **Accounting Start** | From R240/month | 1 user | Sole traders, freelancers, micro-businesses |
| **Accounting Standard** | From R435/month | 2 users (up to 5) | Growing small businesses |
| **Add-on: Multi-Currency** | ~R165/month | - | Foreign currency transactions |
| **Add-on: Time Tracking** | R165/month | - | Project billing, hourly tracking |
| **Add-on: Advanced Inventory** | ~R165/month | - | Warehouse/stock management |
| **Add-on: Debtors Manager** | ~R165/month | - | Collections automation |
| **Sage Payroll** | Separate subscription | Per company | Payroll processing |

> Additional users can be added to Standard for an extra fee per user.

---

## 1. Dashboard & Overview

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Financial dashboard | Yes | All | Visual money in/out per month |
| Cash position widget | Yes | All | Real-time bank balance display |
| Outstanding invoices widget | Yes | All | Total owed by customers |
| Bills to pay widget | Yes | All | Total owed to suppliers |
| Profit & Loss summary | Yes | All | Current period P&L snapshot |
| Cash flow forecast chart | Yes | Standard | Visual forecast of future cash |

| KPI tiles/ratios | No | - | No gross margin %, current ratio, etc. on dashboard |
| Multi-company dashboard | No | - | Single company per login (no group overview) |

**Limitations:** Dashboard is functional but basic compared to competitors. No custom KPI widgets, no configurable date ranges on dashboard widgets, no sparkline trends.

---

## 2. Chart of Accounts / General Ledger

|---------|-----------|------|-------|

## 3. Customers / Accounts Receivable

## 4. Suppliers / Accounts Payable

## Summary: Competitive Strengths & Weaknesses

### Strengths
1. **Strong SA bank feed integration** -- direct feeds with all major SA banks
2. **SARS compliance** -- VAT201 electronic submission, payroll tax compliance
3. **Affordable entry price** -- R240/month for Start plan
4. **Customer portal** -- Online invoice viewing, quote acceptance, payments
5. **Mobile app** -- Functional iOS/Android app for on-the-go invoicing
6. **Recurring invoices** -- Automated scheduling with email delivery
7. **CaseWare integration** -- Important for SA accountants
8. **Netcash batch payments** -- Automated supplier payment processing
9. **Established brand** -- Trusted by SA accountants, large partner network

### Weaknesses
1. **No fixed asset management** -- Critical gap for SA businesses
2. **No purchase orders** -- Cannot do procurement workflow
3. **No AI features** -- All AI investment goes to Sage Intacct
4. **No custom reports** -- Cannot build bespoke report layouts
5. **No multi-entity/consolidation** -- Each company is isolated
6. **No OCR/document capture** -- Manual data entry required
7. **No approval workflows** -- For invoices, bills, or payments
8. **No tracking categories** -- Cannot tag transactions to departments/projects at GL level
9. **Basic inventory** -- No multi-warehouse, serial, batch, or assembly
10. **No WIP tracking** -- Inadequate for professional services firms
11. **Payroll is separate** -- Additional cost, not integrated real-time
12. **Feature gating via add-ons** -- Multi-currency, time tracking, inventory all cost extra
13. **No report scheduling** -- Cannot automate report distribution
14. **Limited budgeting** -- Single version, no forecasting
15. **Small app marketplace** -- Fewer integrations than Xero/QuickBooks

   - No tracking categories/departments
   - Basic inventory (no multi-warehouse, serial, batch)

2. **Where Sage is strong (ISAFlow must match):**
   - Direct bank feeds with all major SA banks (FNB, Standard Bank, Nedbank, ABSA, Capitec)
   - SARS VAT201 electronic submission
   - CaseWare Africa integration
   - Netcash batch payments integration
   - Customer portal (view invoices, accept quotes, pay online)

   - Established SA accountant network and brand trust

3. **Add-on fatigue:** Multi-currency, time tracking, advanced inventory, and debtors manager are all paid add-ons (~R165/month each), meaning a fully-featured Sage setup can cost R900+/month.

file.content:
# Sage Business Cloud Accounting (South Africa) - Comprehensive Feature Analysis

> **Purpose:** Competitive comparison reference document for ISAFlow
> **Product:** Sage Business Cloud Accounting (formerly Sage One / Sage 0)
> **Region:** South Africa (en-za)
> **Last Updated:** 2026-04-05

---

## Pricing Tiers (ZAR, incl. VAT)

| Plan | Price | Users | Target |
|------|-------|-------|--------|
| **Accounting Start** | From R240/month | 1 user | Sole traders, freelancers, micro-businesses |
| **Accounting Standard** | From R435/month | 2 users (up to 5) | Growing small businesses |
| **Add-on: Multi-Currency** | ~R165/month | - | Foreign currency transactions |
| **Add-on: Time Tracking** | R165/month | - | Project billing, hourly tracking |
| **Add-on: Advanced Inventory** | ~R165/month | - | Warehouse/stock management |
| **Add-on: Debtors Manager** | ~R165/month | - | Collections automation |
| **Sage Payroll** | Separate subscription | Per company | Payroll processing |

> Additional users can be added to Standard for an extra fee per user.

---

## 1. Dashboard & Overview

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Financial dashboard | Yes | All | Visual money in/out per month |
| Cash position widget | Yes | All | Real-time bank balance display |
| Outstanding invoices widget | Yes | All | Total owed by customers |
| Bills to pay widget | Yes | All | Total owed to suppliers |
| Profit & Loss summary | Yes | All | Current period P&L snapshot |
| Cash flow forecast chart | Yes | Standard | Visual forecast of future cash |
| Bank account balances | Yes | All | Connected bank accounts shown |
| Overdue invoices alert | Yes | All | Highlights overdue amounts |
| Customisable dashboard | Partial | All | Limited widget arrangement; not drag-and-drop customisable like Xero |
| KPI tiles/ratios | No | - | No gross margin %, current ratio, etc. on dashboard |
| Multi-company dashboard | No | - | Single company per login (no group overview) |

**Limitations:** Dashboard is functional but basic compared to competitors. No custom KPI widgets, no configurable date ranges on dashboard widgets, no sparkline trends.

---

## 2. Chart of Accounts / General Ledger

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Default chart of accounts | Yes | All | Pre-configured ZA-specific COA |
| Custom accounts | Yes | All | Add/edit/deactivate accounts |
| Account categories | Yes | All | Assets, Liabilities, Equity, Revenue, Expenses, Cost of Sales |
| Sub-accounts | Partial | All | Limited hierarchy; not true multi-level nesting |
| Journal entries | Yes | All | General journals with debit/credit |
| Recurring journals | Yes | Standard | Automated periodic journals |
| Opening balances | Yes | All | Via journal entry or take-on balance fields |
| Import COA from CSV | Yes | All | Bulk upload via CSV template |
| Account numbering | Yes | All | Customisable account codes |
| Lock periods | Yes | All | Prevent posting to closed periods |
| Tax codes per account | Yes | All | Default VAT rate per account |
| Departmental tracking | No | - | No tracking categories/departments (use Sage Intacct for this) |
| Multi-segment COA | No | - | Single-segment only |

**Limitations:** No tracking categories or cost centres. No multi-dimensional reporting. Cannot tag transactions to departments/locations/projects at the GL level (projects are a separate add-on). No account-level notes or attachments.

---

## 3. Customers / Accounts Receivable

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Customer contacts | Yes | All | Full customer database with contact details |
| Quotes/Estimates | Yes | All | Create, email, PDF |
| Convert quote to invoice | Yes | All | One-click conversion |
| Sales invoices | Yes | All | Professional templates, customisable |
| Pro-forma invoices | Yes | All | Supported |
| Credit notes | Yes | All | Against invoices or standalone |
| Draft invoices | Yes | All | Save as draft before sending |
| Recurring invoices | Yes | Standard | Automated at scheduled intervals; email auto-send or save as draft |
| Batch/quick entry invoices | Yes | Standard | Enter multiple invoices at once via Quick Entries |
| Customer statements | Yes | All | Generate and email statements |
| Aged Debtors report | Yes | All | 30/60/90/120+ day aging buckets |
| Customer payments/receipts | Yes | All | Record and allocate payments to invoices |
| Payment allocation | Yes | All | Match payments to specific invoices |
| Online invoice viewing | Yes | All | Customers get a link to view invoices online |
| Online quote acceptance | Yes | All | Customers can accept quotes online |
| Customer portal | Yes | All | View invoices, statements, accept quotes, pay online |
| Online card payments | Yes | All | Via Netcash/payment gateway integration |
| Delivery notes | Partial | All | Can be generated from invoices |
| Price lists | Yes | Standard | Trade, retail, distributor price lists per item |
| Customer-specific pricing | Yes | Standard | Assign default price list per customer |
| Discount management | Yes | All | Line-level and invoice-level discounts |
| Email invoices directly | Yes | All | Send from within Sage |
| Invoice templates | Yes | All | Customisable branding, logo, colours |
| Deposit invoices | Partial | All | Can record deposits but limited workflow |
| Foreign currency invoices | Yes | Add-on | Requires Multi-Currency module |
| Debtors Manager (collections) | Yes | Add-on | Automated chase workflow, overdue tracking |

**Limitations:** No approval workflows for invoices. No advanced credit limit management. No automated late payment interest calculation. Customer portal is functional but basic.

---

## 4. Suppliers / Accounts Payable

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Supplier contacts | Yes | All | Full supplier database |
| Supplier invoices | Yes | All | Enter and process purchase invoices |
| Supplier credit notes | Yes | All | Process returns/credits |
| Batch/quick entry bills | Yes | Standard | Via Quick Entries |
| Purchase orders | No | - | NOT available in Sage Business Cloud Accounting. Requires Sage Intacct |
| Supplier payments | Yes | All | Record payments against invoices |
| Batch payments | Yes | Standard | Via Netcash integration; select invoices, generate batch file |
| Payment allocation | Yes | All | Match payments to supplier invoices |
| Aged Creditors report | Yes | All | 30/60/90/120+ day aging |
| Supplier statements reconciliation | Partial | All | Manual comparison |
| Recurring bills | Yes | Standard | Automated periodic supplier invoices |
| Remittance advice | Yes | All | Generate and send to suppliers |
| Approval workflows | No | - | No bill approval process. Requires Sage Intacct |
| Spend limits | No | - | No per-user spending limits |
| Three-way matching (PO/GRN/Invoice) | No | - | No PO module = no matching |

**Limitations:** The absence of purchase orders is a significant gap. No approval workflows for bills. No automated supplier payment runs via EFT (batch payments require Netcash add-on). No OCR/AI bill capture natively (third-party tools required).

---

## 5. Banking & Reconciliation

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Automatic bank feeds | Yes | All | Direct feeds from major SA banks |
| Supported banks | Yes | All | FNB, Standard Bank, Nedbank, ABSA, Capitec, 30+ banks |
| Manual bank statement import | Yes | All | CSV, QIF, OFX file formats |
| Bank reconciliation | Yes | All | Match imported transactions to accounting entries |
| Bank rules | Yes | All | Auto-categorise transactions based on rules |
| Suggested matches | Yes | All | Auto-matching of bank lines to invoices/bills |
| Bank transfers | Yes | All | Record transfers between accounts |
| Multiple bank accounts | Yes | All | Add unlimited bank/credit card accounts |
| Credit card accounts | Yes | All | Treated as bank accounts |
| Petty cash account | Yes | All | Supported |
| Foreign currency bank accounts | Yes | Add-on | Requires Multi-Currency module |
| Bank reconciliation report | Yes | All | Reconciled vs unreconciled view |
| Unreconciled transactions report | Yes | All | List of outstanding items |
| Auto-reconciliation | Partial | All | Rules-based but not fully automatic |
| Split transactions | Yes | All | Split a single bank line across multiple accounts |
| Batch reconciliation | Partial | All | Process multiple lines but one at a time |

**Limitations:** Bank rules are basic compared to competitors (simple keyword matching). No AI-powered categorisation of bank transactions. No batch approval of reconciled items. Bank feeds can have delays of 1-2 days depending on the bank.

---

## 6. Reporting

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| **Financial Reports** | | | |
| Profit & Loss (Income Statement) | Yes | All | With date range, comparison periods |
| Balance Sheet | Yes | All | As at any date |
| Trial Balance | Yes | All | With period filtering |
| Cash Flow Statement | Yes | Standard | Direct method |
| Cash Flow Forecast | Yes | Standard | Visual forecast based on receivables/payables |
| **Transaction Reports** | | | |
| General Ledger | Yes | All | Full transaction detail per account |
| Sales Day Book | Yes | All | All sales transactions |
| Purchase Day Book | Yes | All | All purchase transactions |
| Receipts & Payments Day Book | Yes | All | Cash-based report |
| **AR/AP Reports** | | | |
| Aged Debtors (AR Aging) | Yes | All | By customer, aging buckets |
| Aged Creditors (AP Aging) | Yes | All | By supplier, aging buckets |
| Customer activity | Yes | All | Transaction history per customer |
| Supplier activity | Yes | All | Transaction history per supplier |
| **Tax Reports** | | | |
| VAT summary | Yes | Standard | VAT collected vs paid |
| VAT return (VAT201) | Yes | Standard | SARS-compliant format |
| **Other Reports** | | | |
| Audit Trail | Yes | All | Full transaction log |
| Chart of Accounts listing | Yes | All | Exportable |
| Profit analysis | Yes | Standard | By item/category |
| Sales revenue by product/service | Yes | Standard | Item-level revenue analysis |
| **Report Features** | | | |
| Export to PDF | Yes | All | All reports |
| Export to CSV | Yes | All | All reports |
| Comparative periods | Partial | All | Prior period comparison on P&L and Balance Sheet |
| Custom date ranges | Yes | All | Flexible date filtering |
| Custom reports | No | - | Cannot build custom report layouts |
| Report scheduling/email | No | - | No automated report distribution |
| Financial ratios | No | - | No built-in ratio calculations |
| Budget vs Actual report | Yes | Standard | Compare actual to budget |
| Consolidated reports | No | - | No multi-entity consolidation (Sage Intacct required) |

**Limitations:** No custom report builder. No report scheduling. No management report packs. Limited comparison options (single prior period only). No drill-down from dashboard to underlying transactions on all widgets. No ratio analysis.

---

## 7. VAT / Tax

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| VAT registration support | Yes | Standard | Set up VAT registration details |
| VAT rates configuration | Yes | Standard | Standard (15%), Zero-rated, Exempt, Input/Output |
| VAT on invoices/bills | Yes | Standard | Auto-calculated per line item |
| VAT201 preparation | Yes | Standard | Auto-generated from transactions |
| VAT201 electronic submission | Yes | Standard | Direct to SARS eFiling via Accountants Edition |
| SARS eFiling integration | Yes | Standard | Via ISV activation on SARS eFiling |
| VAT reconciliation | Partial | Standard | Summary report; manual verification needed |
| Income tax calculation | No | - | Not a tax computation tool |
| Provisional tax (IRP6) | No | - | Not supported |
| Tax certificates | No | - | Via Sage Payroll only |

**Limitations:** VAT201 electronic submission can only be done once per period via software (SARS limitation). Resubmissions require manual filing. VAT return is basic; no detailed input/output tax analysis. No Tax section 11 tracking. No customs duty or import VAT tracking.

---

## 8. Payroll

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Employee management | Yes | Separate product | Sage Business Cloud Payroll (separate subscription) |
| Pay runs | Yes | Payroll | Monthly, bi-weekly processing |
| Payslips | Yes | Payroll | Customisable, emailable |
| IRP5 tax certificates | Yes | Payroll | Auto-generated, SARS compliant |
| EMP201 monthly submission | Yes | Payroll | Compile and submit to SARS |
| EMP501 reconciliation | Yes | Payroll | Interim and annual |
| UIF declarations | Yes | Payroll | Department of Labour submission |
| Leave management | Yes | Payroll | BCEA-compliant leave tracking |
| Leave reports | Yes | Payroll | Accrual and usage reports |
| SDL (Skills Development Levy) | Yes | Payroll | Auto-calculated |
| PAYE calculation | Yes | Payroll | Annual tax tables auto-updated |
| Integration with Accounting | Yes | Payroll | Journal posting to Sage Accounting |
| Overtime calculation | Yes | Payroll | Configurable rates |
| Benefits/deductions | Yes | Payroll | Medical aid, pension, etc. |
| Cost-to-company packages | Yes | Payroll | CTC structure support |
| Employee self-service | Partial | Payroll | Limited; view payslips |
| Time & attendance integration | No | Payroll | No biometric/clock integration |
| HR module | Partial | Payroll | Basic employee records; full HR via Sage Premier HR |

**Limitations:** Payroll is a SEPARATE product with its own subscription -- not included in Sage Accounting. Integration is via journal entry, not real-time sync. No advanced HR features (performance management, recruitment) in the basic payroll. No time & attendance hardware integration.

---

## 9. Fixed Assets

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Fixed asset register | No | - | NOT included in Sage Business Cloud Accounting |
| Depreciation calculation | No | - | Available in Sage Pastel, Sage 200 Evolution, or Sage Fixed Assets (separate products) |
| Asset disposal tracking | No | - | Separate product |
| Asset categories | No | - | Separate product |
| Depreciation methods | No | - | Straight-line and diminishing value available in Sage Fixed Assets |
| Asset barcode scanning | No | - | Separate product |
| SARS depreciation rates | No | - | Available in separate Sage Fixed Assets product |

**Limitations:** This is a major gap. Sage Business Cloud Accounting has NO built-in fixed asset management. Users must manually journal depreciation entries or purchase a separate Sage product (Sage Fixed Assets, Sage Pastel Partner, or Sage 200 Evolution).

---

## 10. Inventory / Items

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Item/product setup | Yes | Standard | Stock, non-stock, and service items |
| Bulk item import via CSV | Yes | Standard | Upload items from spreadsheet |
| Stock levels tracking | Yes | Standard | Basic quantity tracking |
| Price lists | Yes | Standard | Multiple price lists (trade, retail, distributor) |
| Customer-specific pricing | Yes | Standard | Default price list per customer |
| Average cost calculation | Yes | Standard | Weighted average cost method |
| Stock adjustments | Yes | Standard | Manual quantity/value adjustments |
| Item categories | Yes | Standard | Group items by category |
| Item notes/descriptions | Yes | Standard | Long and short descriptions |
| **Advanced Inventory (Add-on)** | | | |
| Real-time inventory updates | Yes | Add-on | Updates on every transaction |
| Inventory valuation report | Yes | Add-on | Current stock value |
| Stock movement tracking | Yes | Add-on | In/out movement history |
| Reorder levels/alerts | Partial | Add-on | Basic reorder point |
| Multiple warehouses/locations | No | - | Single location only |
| Serial number tracking | No | - | Not available |
| Batch/lot tracking | No | - | Not available |
| Bill of materials / assembly | No | - | Not available |
| Barcode scanning | No | - | Not available |
| Stocktake functionality | Partial | Add-on | Manual count entry |

**Limitations:** Inventory is basic -- no multi-warehouse, no serial/batch tracking, no manufacturing/assembly, no barcode support. The Start plan has NO inventory at all. The Advanced Inventory add-on improves tracking but remains limited for businesses with complex stock needs.

---

## 11. Projects / Time Tracking

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Project creation | Yes | Add-on | Time Tracking module required |
| Time entry | Yes | Add-on | Log hours against projects |
| Billable/non-billable hours | Yes | Add-on | Mark time entries as billable |
| Expense linking to projects | Yes | Add-on | Link expenses to specific projects |
| Recharge expenses to customers | Yes | Add-on | Invoice project expenses to clients |
| Project profitability reporting | Partial | Add-on | Basic revenue vs cost per project |
| Budgeted vs actual hours | Partial | Add-on | Limited tracking |
| Multiple billing rates | Partial | Add-on | Per-project rates |
| Timesheet approval | No | - | No manager approval workflow |
| Resource scheduling | No | - | No capacity planning |
| Gantt charts / milestones | No | - | No project management features |
| WIP (Work in Progress) tracking | No | - | Not available |

**Limitations:** Time Tracking is an add-on (R165/month extra). Very basic project management -- no WIP, no milestones, no resource planning. Suitable for simple time-based billing only.

---

## 12. Multi-Currency

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Foreign currency invoicing | Yes | Add-on | Multi-Currency module required |
| Foreign currency bills | Yes | Add-on | Purchase in foreign currencies |
| Foreign currency bank accounts | Yes | Add-on | Hold balances in foreign currencies |
| Automatic exchange rates | Yes | Add-on | Daily rates from openexchangerates.org |
| Manual exchange rate override | Yes | Add-on | Edit rate at transaction time |
| Realised FX gains/losses | Yes | Add-on | Auto-calculated on payment |
| Unrealised FX gains/losses | Yes | Add-on | Auto-calculated at period end |
| Base currency | Yes | Add-on | ZAR as default; configurable |
| Number of currencies | Yes | Add-on | 150+ currencies supported |
| Multi-currency reporting | Partial | Add-on | Reports in base currency only |

**Limitations:** Multi-Currency is a paid add-on (~R165/month). Reports are only in base currency (no dual-currency reports). No consolidated reporting across currencies. Exchange rate source is openexchangerates.org (free tier has limitations).

---

## 13. Document Management

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| File attachments on transactions | Yes | All | Attach files to invoices, bills, etc. |
| Receipt photo capture | Yes | Standard | Snap and upload via mobile app |
| Invoice photo capture | Yes | Standard | Upload supplier invoices from photos |
| Document storage | Yes | All | Cloud-based storage with Sage |
| OCR (Optical Character Recognition) | No | - | No native OCR in Sage Accounting. Third-party tools (Nanonets, Receipt Bot, AutoEntry) integrate |
| AI document capture | No | - | Available in Sage Intacct only (not Sage Accounting) |
| Bulk document upload | No | - | One at a time |
| Document approval workflow | No | - | Not available |
| Searchable document archive | Partial | All | Basic search; not full-text search of document content |

**Limitations:** No native OCR or AI document capture. Users must manually enter data from uploaded documents or use third-party OCR integrations. Document management is basic file attachment only.

---

## 14. AI Features

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| AI-powered categorisation | No | - | Not in Sage Accounting (available in Sage Intacct) |
| AI Copilot / assistant | No | - | Sage Copilot is Sage Intacct only (launched 2024-2025) |
| Smart bank matching | Partial | All | Rule-based, not ML-based |
| Predictive cash flow | No | - | Not in Sage Accounting (Sage Intacct feature) |
| AI invoice data extraction | No | - | Sage Intacct only |
| Natural language queries | No | - | Sage Intacct Copilot only |
| Anomaly detection | No | - | Not available |
| AI commentary / insights | No | - | Not available |

**Limitations:** Sage Business Cloud Accounting has essentially NO AI features. Sage's AI investment (Sage Copilot, AI document capture, predictive analytics) is focused entirely on Sage Intacct, the enterprise product. This is a significant competitive gap for the SME product.

---

## 15. Integrations

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| **Bank Feeds** | | | |
| FNB | Yes | All | Direct feed partnership |
| Standard Bank | Yes | All | Direct feed |
| Nedbank | Yes | All | Direct feed |
| ABSA | Yes | All | Direct feed |
| Capitec | Yes | All | Direct feed |
| 30+ SA banks | Yes | All | Via Sage Banking Service |
| **Payment Gateways** | | | |
| Netcash | Yes | All | Payments, collections, batch EFT |
| Card payments on invoices | Yes | All | Online card payment links |
| PayFast | Partial | All | Via marketplace |
| **Third-Party Apps** | | | |
| Sage Marketplace | Yes | All | za-marketplace.sage.com |
| CaseWare Africa | Yes | All | Trial balance export, audit integration |
| GAAP Point of Sale | Yes | All | POS integration |
| Flowgear (iPaaS) | Yes | All | API integration platform |
| Sage Payroll | Yes | All | Journal integration |
| CRM integrations | Partial | All | Limited marketplace options |
| E-commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce) | Partial | All | Via third-party connectors |
| **API** | | | |
| REST API | Yes | All | Sage Developer Portal available |
| Webhooks | Partial | All | Limited event types |

**Limitations:** Marketplace is smaller than Xero/QuickBooks. Limited native integrations. No Zapier-level automation. API is available but documentation is sometimes outdated. No native e-commerce integration -- requires middleware.

---

## 16. User Management

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Multiple users | Yes | Standard | Up to 5 users (Start = 1 user only) |
| Additional users (paid) | Yes | Standard | Extra cost per user beyond included |
| Role-based permissions | Yes | Standard | Menu-level access control |
| Per-function permissions | Yes | Standard | Granular checkboxes per menu item |
| User activity tracking | Yes | All | Audit trail of user actions |
| Two-factor authentication (2FA) | Yes | All | Via Sage ID |
| Single sign-on (SSO) | Partial | All | Sage ID acts as SSO across Sage products |
| IP restrictions | No | - | No IP-based access control |
| Custom roles | Partial | Standard | Per-user permission sets (not named roles) |
| User invitation via email | Yes | Standard | Invite by email address |

**Limitations:** Start plan is single-user only. Standard allows up to 5 users. No named role templates (must configure permissions per user). No IP restriction or geo-fencing. No session management.

---

## 17. Audit Trail

| Feature | Available | Tier | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|

## Summary: Competitive Strengths & Weaknesses

### Strengths
1. **Strong SA bank feed integration** -- direct feeds with all major SA banks
2. **SARS compliance** -- VAT201 electronic submission, payroll tax compliance
3. **Affordable entry price** -- R240/month for Start plan
4. **Customer portal** -- Online invoice viewing, quote acceptance, payments
5. **Mobile app** -- Functional iOS/Android app for on-the-go invoicing
6. **Recurring invoices** -- Automated scheduling with email delivery
7. **CaseWare integration** -- Important for SA accountants
8. **Netcash batch payments** -- Automated supplier payment processing
9. **Established brand** -- Trusted by SA accountants, large partner network

### Weaknesses
1. **No fixed asset management** -- Critical gap for SA businesses
2. **No purchase orders** -- Cannot do procurement workflow
3. **No AI features** -- All AI investment goes to Sage Intacct
4. **No custom reports** -- Cannot build bespoke report layouts
5. **No multi-entity/consolidation** -- Each company is isolated
6. **No OCR/document capture** -- Manual data entry required
7. **No approval workflows** -- For invoices, bills, or payments
8. **No tracking categories** -- Cannot tag transactions to departments/projects at GL level
9. **Basic inventory** -- No multi-warehouse, serial, batch, or assembly
10. **No WIP tracking** -- Inadequate for professional services firms
11. **Payroll is separate** -- Additional cost, not integrated real-time
12. **Feature gating via add-ons** -- Multi-currency, time tracking, inventory all cost extra
13. **No report scheduling** -- Cannot automate report distribution
14. **Limited budgeting** -- Single version, no forecasting
15. **Small app marketplace** -- Fewer integrations than Xero/QuickBooks

| Company admin | Yes | All | Full access except removing primary admin |
| Standard users | Yes | Varies | 1 (SS), 3 (Ess), 5 (Plus), 25 (Adv) |
| Accountant user (free) | Yes | All | Free accountant invite; admin-level access |
| Custom user roles | Yes | Advanced only | Define granular permissions |
| View-only access | Yes | All | Reports-only users |
| Time tracking only users | Yes | Essentials+ | Limited to time entry |
| Two-factor authentication | Yes | All | MFA via Intuit account |
| SSO (Single Sign-On) | No | -- | Not supported |
| IP restrictions | No | -- | Not supported |

**Limitations:** Non-Advanced plans have fixed user limits and roles. No custom roles except on Advanced. No SSO or IP whitelisting. Accountant user has full admin access (no granular accountant permissions). No user activity monitoring beyond audit log.

---

## 17. Audit Trail

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Audit log | Yes | All | Tracks all user activity |
| Transaction history | Yes | All | Created, edited, deleted transactions |
| User identification | Yes | All | Who made each change |
| Timestamps | Yes | All | Date/time of every action |
| Login tracking | Yes | All | User login events |
| Retention period | Yes | All | 2 years of audit log data |
| Admin-only access | Yes | All | Only admins can view audit log |
| Export audit log | Partial | All | Can view but limited export options |
| Field-level change tracking | Yes | All | Shows before/after values |

**Limitations:** Only 2-year retention. Only admins can access. Limited export capabilities. No compliance-specific audit reports. No audit log API access. Cannot track report generation or data exports in log.

---

## 18. Data Export

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Report export to Excel | Yes | All | .xlsx format |
| Report export to PDF | Yes | All | All reports |
| CSV export | No (native) | -- | Must export Excel then convert |
| CaseWare export (.cwq) | Yes | All | Via QuickBooks Export Utility |
| Trial Balance export | Yes | All | For auditor use |
| General Ledger export | Yes | All | Full GL detail |
| Backup & restore | Yes | Advanced | Full company data backup |
| Data export (full) | Partial | All | Can export lists and reports; no single full-data dump |
| API data access | Yes | All | Programmatic data extraction |

**Limitations:** No native CSV export. CaseWare integration requires separate utility download. No one-click full data export. Backup/restore only in Advanced. No XBRL export. No iXBRL for CIPC filing.

---

## 19. Mobile / Portal

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| iOS mobile app | Yes | All | Full-featured mobile app |
| Android mobile app | Yes | All | Full-featured mobile app |
| Create invoices (mobile) | Yes | All | Create and send from phone |
| Receipt capture (mobile) | Yes | All | Camera-based receipt scanning |
| Bank feed review (mobile) | Yes | All | Categorize transactions on the go |
| Mileage tracking | Yes | All | GPS-based mileage logging |
| Client/customer portal | Partial | All | Invoice view and pay only |
| Accountant portal (QBOA) | Yes | N/A | Free QuickBooks Online Accountant platform |

**Limitations:** Customer portal is invoice-payment only, not a full self-service portal. No supplier portal. Mobile app feature parity lags behind web. No offline mode for mobile app.

---

## 20. Group / Multi-Entity

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Multiple companies | No (native) | -- | One company per subscription |
| Consolidated reporting | No (native) | -- | Requires third-party (LiveFlow, Joiin, Fathom) |
| Intercompany transactions | No | -- | Must be done manually across separate subscriptions |
| Group chart of accounts | No | -- | Each entity has independent COA |
| Multi-entity dashboard | No | -- | Via third-party only |
| Elimination entries | No | -- | Via third-party only |

**Limitations:** QBO has ZERO native multi-entity/group capability. Each company requires a separate subscription. No intercompany eliminations, no consolidated reporting, no group management. This is a major gap for accounting firms and groups. Third-party tools (LiveFlow, Joiin, Fathom, FinBoard) fill this gap at additional cost.

---

## 21. Budgeting

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| Budget creation | Yes | Plus, Advanced | Annual P&L budgets |
| Budget vs Actual report | Yes | Plus, Advanced | Variance analysis |
| Budget by class | Yes | Plus, Advanced | Segment budgets |
| Budget by location | Yes | Plus, Advanced | Location-based budgets |
| Multiple budgets | Yes | Plus, Advanced | Can create multiple budget scenarios |
| Budget import | Partial | Advanced | Import budget data |
| Cash flow budgeting | No | -- | P&L budgets only; no cash flow budget |
| Rolling forecasts | No | -- | Static annual budgets only |
| Driver-based budgeting | No | -- | Requires third-party (Jirav, Vena) |

**Limitations:** Not available in Simple Start or Essentials. P&L budgets only -- no balance sheet or cash flow budgets. No rolling/flexible budgets. No collaborative budgeting workflows. No scenario planning. Static annual budgets only.

---

## 22. Compliance (South Africa Specific)

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|
| VAT @ 15% (pre-configured) | Yes | All | SA VAT rate built in |
| VAT return preparation | Yes | All | Data for SARS VAT201 |
| SARS eFiling integration | No | -- | Manual transfer required |
| IRP5 generation | No | -- | Via third-party payroll |
| EMP201/EMP501 | No | -- | Via third-party payroll |
| B-BBEE reporting | No | -- | Not supported |
| CIPC annual returns | No | -- | Not supported |
| IFRS compliance | Partial | All | Produces IFRS-aligned reports but no explicit IFRS tagging |
| Companies Act reporting | No | -- | No statutory report templates |
| Dividend withholding tax | No | -- | Not supported |
| SDL/UIF calculations | No | -- | Via third-party payroll |
| PAYE tables | No | -- | Via third-party payroll |
| Tax year (March) | Yes | All | Can set financial year to March |

**Limitations:** QBO ZA is essentially the global product with ZA VAT bolted on. No deep SA compliance features. All payroll compliance requires third-party. No B-BBEE, no CIPC, no Companies Act, no dividend tax support. SARS integration is manual only.

---

## Summary: Key Competitive Gaps in QBO ZA

1. **No native SA payroll** -- Must use SimplePay/PaySpace as paid add-on
2. **No multi-entity/consolidation** -- Each company is siloed
3. **No SARS eFiling integration** -- Manual VAT/tax submission
4. **No SA payment gateways** -- No PayFast, Paystack, SnapScan
5. **Fixed assets only on Advanced** -- Most expensive plan required
6. **No B-BBEE compliance** -- No scorecard or reporting
7. **Limited inventory** -- No multi-warehouse, no serial/batch tracking
8. **Budgeting only on Plus+** -- Not available on entry plans
9. **No native CSV export** -- Excel only, then manual conversion
10. **User limits per plan** -- 1/3/5/25 user caps
11. **No custom user roles** except Advanced plan
12. **No SSO/IP restrictions** -- Limited enterprise security
13. **AI features US-first** -- SA rollout lags behind

## Xero Payroll Integration in South Africa

Xero has launched a payroll integration with SimplePay, allowing accountants to eFile employee tax declarations (EMP201s) from Xero to the South African Revenue Service (SARS). Accountants and bookkeepers using Xero Practice Manager and SimplePay can set up EMP201 returns for their clients to automatically submit to SARS each month, which means once they complete a payroll run the EMP201 returns will automatically eFile to SARS.

## South African Payroll Forms & 2025 Requirements

SimplePay assists South African clients by generating IRP5s, EMP201s, and EMP501s to simplify the process of submitting to SARS.

For 2025 specific deadlines:
- The Employer Interim Reconciliation submission period is from 22 September to 31 October 2025, during which all employers must reconcile their declarations for the first six months of the reconciliation year (1 March 2025 to 31 August 2025), and must submit an accurate EMP501 using e@syFile™ Employer or SARS eFiling by 31 October 2025 to avoid penalties.

- The monthly EMP201 declaration and payment for PAYE, UIF, and SDL must be submitted to SARS by the 7th day of the following month, and if the 7th falls on a weekend or public holiday, submission and payment must be made on the last business day before the 7th.

## Current Xero Inventory Options

Xero's core software does not support FIFO (first in, first out) or Average Cost inventory valuation. However, Xero offers multiple solutions to address this:

content.text:
Now I have enough to compile a comprehensive comparison. Here is the full breakdown:

---

## Xero South Africa — Feature Availability Matrix

**Plans:** Starter (lowest) | Standard | Premium | Add-on (paid extra) | Third-party (not native)

---

### 1. Dashboard

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Financial dashboard | YES | All | Basic cash in/out, account balances |
| Custom KPIs | Partial | Add-on | Analytics Plus add-on required for KPI scorecard |
| Cash flow forecast | Partial | Add-on | Short-term only via Analytics Plus; basic 30-day included free |
| Configurable widgets | NO | — | Dashboard is fixed layout; no drag-and-drop widget config |

---

### 2. General Ledger

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chart of accounts | YES | All | Standard COA included |
| Manual journals | YES | All | |
| Recurring journals | YES | All | |
| Opening balances | YES | All | |
| Lock periods | YES | All | |
| Cost centres / Tracking categories | Partial | All | 2 tracking categories max, 100 options each — not true multi-segment COA |
| Multi-segment COA | NO | — | Not natively; 2-category cap is a hard limit |
| Year-end close | Partial | All | No formal close process; manual locking only |

---

### 3. Accounts Receivable

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Invoicing | YES | All | Starter capped at 20/month |
| Quotes | YES | All | Starter capped at 20/month combined with invoices |
| Credit notes | YES | All | |
| Recurring invoices | YES | All | |
| Customer statements | YES | All | |
| AR aging | YES | All | |
| Customer portal | Partial | Third-party | No native portal; Paidnice app adds this |
| Online payments | YES | All | PayFast, Stripe, GoCardless via integrations |
| Automated reminders | YES | All | Native automated invoice reminders |
| Sales orders | NO | — | Not a native Xero feature; POs exist on AP side only |
| Approval workflows | Partial | Third-party | ApprovalMax add-on needed for AR approval chains |
| Write-offs | YES | All | Via credit note to bad debt account |

---

### 4. Accounts Payable

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Supplier invoices (Bills) | YES | All | Starter capped at 5 bills/month |
| Purchase orders | YES | All | Basic PO with draft/approve/billed status |
| 3-way matching (PO+Bill+GRN) | NO | Third-party | Not native; ApprovalMax or ProcureDesk required |
| GRN (Goods Received Note) | NO | — | No native GRN functionality |
| AP aging | YES | All | |
| Batch payments | YES | All | Native batch payment grouping |
| EFT file generation (SA banks) | Partial | Third-party | Paysoft Flow app generates SA bank EFT files |
| Bill approval workflow | Partial | All | Basic approve/reject built in; complex routing via ApprovalMax |
| DRC VAT (Domestic Reverse Charge) | Partial | All | VAT adjustments possible but no dedicated DRC automation |

---

### 5. Banking

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank feeds — SA banks | YES | All | FNB, ABSA, Nedbank, Standard Bank confirmed |
| CSV/OFX import | YES | All | |
| PDF statement import | NO | — | Not native; Hubdoc can extract from PDF bills, not bank statements |
| Bank rules | YES | All | Condition-based auto-categorisation rules |
| AI categorisation | YES | All | Smart suggestions learn from patterns |
| Smart matching | YES | All | AI-driven transaction matching to invoices/bills |
| Transfers | YES | All | |
| Reconciliation report | YES | All | Bank reconciliation summary report |
| Batch reconciliation | YES | All | Sort/filter/search in recon view |

---

### 6. Reporting

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Income statement (P&L) | YES | All | |
| Balance sheet | YES | All | |
| Trial balance | YES | All | |
| Cash flow statement | YES | All | Direct/indirect method |
| Financial ratios | Partial | Add-on | Analytics Plus |
| KPI scorecard | Partial | Add-on | Analytics Plus |
| Executive summary | Partial | Add-on | Basic summary available; rich exec dashboards via Analytics Plus |
| Management packs | Partial | All | Basic multi-report packs; no automated PDF bundling like dedicated tools |
| Board packs | Partial | Third-party | Spotlight Reporting, Fathom, dataSights |
| 3-way forecast (P&L+BS+CF) | NO | Third-party | Not native; Spotlight Reporting, Calxa, Float |
| Trend analysis | Partial | All | Basic trend in P&L; deeper via Analytics Plus |
| Waterfall charts | NO | Third-party | Not native |
| Budget vs actual | YES | All | Built into P&L with layout editor |
| Custom report builder | Partial | All | Layout editor for columns/rows; not a free-form builder |
| Report pack PDF export | Partial | All | Can print/export individual reports; no one-click multi-report PDF bundle natively |
| CaseWare export | NO | Third-party | No native integration; manual export |
| Consolidated reports | NO | Third-party | Joiin, Translucent, dataSights required |
| IFRS disclosure notes | NO | — | Not supported |

---

### 7. VAT / Tax

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| VAT tracking | YES | All | |
| VAT201 preparation | YES | All | Auto-populates from transactions |
| SARS eFiling (VAT) | YES | All | Direct eFiling integration with SARS |
| EMP201 | Partial | Add-on | Via SimplePay integration + Xero Practice Manager |
| EMP501 | Partial | Add-on | Via SimplePay |
| IRP5 | Partial | Add-on | Via SimplePay |
| IRP6 (Provisional tax) | Partial | Add-on | Xero Practice Manager workflow for accountants |
| Compliance calendar | Partial | Add-on | Via Xero Practice Manager (accountant tool) |
| VAT adjustments (late claims) | YES | All | Native late VAT claims tool |

---

### 8. Payroll

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Native SA payroll | NO | — | Xero has NO native SA payroll module |
| Employees / Pay runs / Payslips | Partial | Third-party | SimplePay integration (separate subscription) |
| IRP5 / EMP201 / EMP501 | Partial | Third-party | SimplePay generates; EMP201 auto-eFiles via integration |
| Leave management | Partial | Third-party | SimplePay |
| Overtime | Partial | Third-party | SimplePay |
| Integrated with accounting | Partial | Third-party | SimplePay posts journals to Xero |

> **Key gap:** Xero has native payroll in AU/UK/NZ but NOT SA. SimplePay is the recommended SA-specific partner.

---

### 9. Fixed Assets

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Asset register | YES | All | |
| Depreciation methods | Partial | All | Straight-line and diminishing value (reducing balance) only |
| SARS wear-and-tear rates | NO | — | No SA tax depreciation schedules built in |
| Disposal | YES | All | |
| Asset categories | YES | All | |
| Depreciation schedule report | YES | All | |
| Auto-post depreciation | YES | All | Automated journal posting |

---

### 10. Inventory

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Products/services | YES | All | |
| Stock tracking (quantity) | Partial | Add-on | Basic: WAC in core. FIFO + proper tracking via Inventory Plus add-on |
| WAC | YES | All | Native (core Products & Services) |
| FIFO | Partial | Add-on | Inventory Plus add-on (launched GA Aug 2024) |
| Inventory adjustments | YES | All | |
| Price lists | NO | — | Not native |
| Reorder alerts | NO | Third-party | Not native; add-ons like Unleashed, DEAR |

---

### 11. Projects

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project tracking | YES | Add-on | Xero Projects — paid per-user add-on |
| Time entries | YES | Add-on | |
| Project profitability | YES | Add-on | |
| WIP reporting | NO | — | No native WIP; gaps noted even in Projects |
| Billable time to invoice | YES | Add-on | Convert project time to invoice |

---

### 12. AI Features

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| AI categorisation | YES | All | Bank recon smart suggestions, learns from patterns |
| AI invoice extraction | YES | All | Hubdoc LLM-based extraction (included in all plans) |
| AI commentary | NO | — | No native narrative commentary generation |
| Natural language queries | Partial | All | JAX conversational assistant (rolling out 2025) |
| Anomaly detection | Partial | All | Flags unusual transactions during recon; not a dedicated module |
| AI forecast | Partial | Add-on | Analytics Plus short-term cash flow forecast |

---

### 13. Documents

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Attachments | YES | All | Attach files to any transaction |
| OCR (via Hubdoc) | YES | All | Hubdoc included in all plans |
| VLM / advanced extraction | Partial | All | Hubdoc LLM reads receipts, invoices, rental statements |
| Multi-doc upload | YES | All | Via Hubdoc |
| Validation | Partial | All | Hubdoc extracts and suggests; user confirms before publishing |
| Auto-create invoice/bill | YES | All | Hubdoc publishes draft bill/invoice to Xero |

---

### 14. Multi-Currency

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Foreign invoicing | YES | Premium only | Locked to Premium plan |
| Foreign bank accounts | YES | Premium only | |
| Auto exchange rates (hourly) | YES | Premium only | |
| FX gains/losses | YES | Premium only | Auto-calculated |
| Included in base price | NO | Premium only | Must upgrade from Standard |

---

### 15. Users / Security

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Multi-user | YES | All | Unlimited users on all plans |
| Role-based access | YES | All | Standard roles (Admin, Standard, Read-only, Invoicing, etc.) |
| 2FA | YES | All | |
| Audit trail | YES | All | Transaction-level history |
| Approval workflows | Partial | Third-party | Native basic approve/reject; complex routing via ApprovalMax |
| Data archiving | Partial | All | Archived organisations only; no granular record archiving |
| POPIA | Partial | All | Xero is GDPR-compliant; no SA-specific POPIA tooling |

---

### 16. SA Compliance

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| BEE | NO | — | No BEE compliance features whatsoever |
| SARS compliance calendar | Partial | Add-on | Via Xero Practice Manager (accountants) |
| Month-end checklist | NO | — | Not native |
| Year-end close | Partial | All | Lock dates only; no structured close workflow |
| POPIA data rights | NO | — | No native POPIA data subject request tooling |

---

| Feature | Available | Plan | Notes |

| Multi-company | YES | All | Separate Xero orgs, each billed separately |
| Consolidated reporting | NO | Third-party | Joiin, Translucent, dataSights |

> **Critical gap:** Xero has explicitly confirmed consolidated reporting is NOT planned natively.

payload.prompt: I want you to create an autonomous loop every 30 minutes and run checks on the full code base and find something you can improve. Make sure there are tests beforehand that pass. We've got an extensive amount of tests that we've built, so make sure that it passes beforehand. Then run your loop, do the improvements, make sure the tests pass afterwards as well.

tool_input.args:
30m Run autonomous codebase improvement cycle:

1. **Pre-check**: Run `bun test` to verify all existing tests pass. If any fail, stop and report — do not proceed with improvements on a broken baseline.

2. **Find improvement**: Analyze the codebase for one concrete improvement. Prioritize in this order:
   - Security issues (SQL injection, missing auth checks, IDOR)
   - Type safety gaps (any types, missing null checks)
   - Dead code removal (unused imports, unreachable code)
   - Code quality (functions over 300 lines, duplicated logic)
   - Performance (N+1 queries, missing indexes)
   
   Use agents to scan in parallel. Pick ONE focused improvement per cycle — don't try to fix everything at once.

3. **Implement**: Make the fix. Keep changes minimal and surgical.

4. **Post-check**: Run `bun test` again to verify all tests still pass after the change.

5. **Report**: Summarize what was found, what was changed, and test results (before/after).

If tests fail after the change, revert immediately with `git checkout -- .` and report what went wrong.

1. **Pre-check**: Run `bun test` to verify all existing tests pass. If any fail, stop and report — do not proceed with improvements on a broken baseline.

2. **Find improvement**: Analyze the codebase for one concrete improvement. Prioritize in this order:
   - Security issues (SQL injection, missing auth checks, IDOR)
   - Type safety gaps (any types, missing null checks)
   - Dead code removal (unused imports, unreachable code)
   - Code quality (functions over 300 lines, duplicated logic)
   - Performance (N+1 queries, missing indexes)
   
   Use agents to scan in parallel. Pick ONE focused improvement per cycle — don't try to fix everything at once.

3. **Implement**: Make the fix. Keep changes minimal and surgical.

4. **Post-check**: Run `bun test` again to verify all tests still pass after the change.

5. **Report**: Summarize what was found, what was changed, and test results (before/after).

If tests fail after the change, revert immediately with `git checkout -- .` and report what went wrong.

tool_input.prompt:
Search the IsaFlow codebase for API routes in `pages/api/accounting/` that have potential issues with unchecked `Number()` conversions on query parameters. Specifically find patterns where `Number(req.query.something)` is used without checking for NaN, which could cause SQL errors or unexpected behavior.

Also look for routes that destructure `req.body` without any validation — where the route just does `const { field1, field2 } = req.body` and passes directly to SQL without checking if the required fields exist.

Check at least 15 API files. Report file paths, line numbers, and the specific pattern. Quick search.

| File | Line | Pattern | Issue |
|------|------|---------|-------|
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/accounting-settings.ts` | 25 | `const { key, value } = req.body;` | Checks exist but destructures without types |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/consolidated-reports.ts` | 113 | `const { periodStart, periodEnd } = req.body;` | **No validation before use in SQL** (line 48) |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/customer-invoices-detail.ts` | 56 | `const { id, notes, internalNotes, dueDate } = req.body;` | Checks id but not others; uses in SQL COALESCE (line 59-64) |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/customer-invoices-detail.ts` | 72 | `const { id, action } = req.body;` | Basic check but action could be malicious |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/supplier-categories.ts` | 40 | `const { name, description } = req.body;` | Checks name.trim() but description used without validation (line 44) |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/supplier-allocations.ts` | 79 | `const { paymentId, allocations } = req.body as {...}` | Type assertion but array items not validated (line 89-92 validates later) |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/recurring-invoices-action.ts` | 24 | `const { action, id } = req.body;` | Checks exist (line 26) but action enum not strictly validated |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/invoice-email.ts` | 20 | `const { invoiceId, recipientEmail } = req.body;` | **Does validate both (lines 22-28) - GOOD** |

| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/soft-delete.ts` | 69 | `const { entityType, entityId } = req.body as {...}` | Same validation pattern |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/company-users.ts` | 32 | `const { userId, role } = req.body as {...}` | Validates both (line 33) - **GOOD** |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/company-invitations.ts` | 47 | `const { email, role } = req.body as {...}` | Type assertion; validation likely follows |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/year-end.ts` | 32 | `const { yearLabel, action } = req.body;` | Validates yearLabel (line 38) but action is enum-checked (line 34) |
| `/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/accounting/eft-generate.ts` | 31 | `const { batchId, bank } = req.body;` | Validates both (lines 32-33) with bank enum check - **GOOD** |

---

### **Summary of High-Risk Patterns**

1. **Query param `Number()` conversions without NaN checks**: At least **10 routes** have this issue. When `Number()` returns `NaN`, fallback operators like `|| 6` still pass `NaN` in some contexts.

2. **SARS routes vulnerability**: Files `sars-compliance.ts`, `emp501.ts`, and `compliance-calendar.ts` directly convert year/taxYear to `Number()` then pass to services — if malicious input like `req.query.year="aaa"` is sent, `Number("aaa")` → `NaN`, which may cause unexpected SQL behavior.

3. **Unvalidated destructuring**: Routes like `consolidated-reports.ts` and `customer-invoices-detail.ts` destructure multiple fields from `req.body` without type-checking all of them before SQL insertion.

**Recommendation**: Add `!isNaN()` checks after all `Number()` conversions, and validate all destructured fields exist and have expected types before SQL usage.

-- or their own creation migration.
--
-- Already indexed in 220: gl_accounts, gl_journal_entries, customer_invoices,
--   supplier_invoices, customers, suppliers, bank_transactions, bank_reconciliations,
--   credit_notes, fiscal_periods, customer_payments, supplier_payments, stock_items,
--   recurring_invoices, recurring_journals, vat_adjustments, cost_centres,
--   exchange_rates, customer_quotes, customer_sales_orders, purchase_orders.
--
-- Already indexed in their own migration: approval_rules, approval_requests are
--   missing company_id entirely (234_approval_workflows.sql did not add it).
--   payroll_runs has idx_payroll_runs_company_id (added in 230).
--   stock_items has idx_stock_items_company (added in 255).
--
-- This migration adds indexes for tables confirmed to exist but not yet indexed:

-- approval_rules and approval_requests — company_id was not added in 234.
-- Add the column first (idempotent), then index it.
ALTER TABLE approval_rules    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id);
ALTER TABLE approval_requests ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_approval_rules_company    ON approval_rules(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_approval_requests_company ON approval_requests(company_id);

-- journal_entries is not a standalone table in this schema (the table is
-- gl_journal_entries, already indexed). Skipped.

-- description_templates — this table name resolves to transaction_description_templates
-- in the codebase (see idx_desc_templates_company already created).
-- Skipped to avoid duplicate.

-- write_offs — the actual table is customer_write_offs, already indexed in 220.
-- Skipped.

-- adjustments — the actual table is accounting_adjustments, already indexed in 220.
-- Skipped.

-- batch_payments — the actual table is supplier_payment_batches, already indexed in 220.
-- Skipped.

-- fixed_assets — the actual table is assets (created in fixed_assets migration).
-- idx_assets_company already exists. Skipped.

-- budgets — the actual table is accounting_budgets, already indexed in 220.
-- Skipped.

-- payslips — company_id not present on this table yet (payroll scopes by
-- payroll_run which has company_id, but direct company_id is useful).
ALTER TABLE payslips ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS company_id UUID REFERENCES companies(id);

-- Backfill company_id on payslips from parent payroll_run
UPDATE payslips ps
SET company_id = pr.company_id
FROM payroll_runs pr
WHERE ps.payroll_run_id = pr.id
  AND ps.company_id IS NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payslips_company ON payslips(company_id);
